title: Single-cell RNA-seq of murine cortical neurons under chronic stress
abstract: We profile cortical neurons under chronic stress using single-cell RNA-seq.

methods.name: methods
methods.text: Mice were housed under standard conditions. Cortical tissue was dissociated into single-cell suspensions as described in Bremer et al. 2021 [ref_1]. Libraries were prepared using the 10x Genomics Chromium platform following the manufacturer's instructions. Sequencing was performed on an Illumina NovaSeq 6000 with 100bp paired-end reads. Reads were aligned to GRCm39 using STAR v2.7.10a with default parameters. Differential expression was computed using DESeq2 v1.36 with an adjusted p-value threshold of 0.05. Statistical analysis followed the framework of Chen et al. 2020 [ref_2]. Briefly, batch effects were corrected. Figures were produced in R version 4.2.1 with ggplot2.
